end.summary:
Practised identifying unit fractions on a number line by splitting 0 to 1 into equal gaps.
Riya asked whether dashes represent gaps, like centimetres on a scale.
Riya said 2/5 means 2 of 5 parts and guessed it is less than 1/2.
No unaided correct attempt was recorded; the teach-back was not passed.
The lesson shifted to triangles, but no triangle picture was available on screen.
end.parentNote: Asha practised splitting 0 to 1 into equal gaps and connecting the second gap with 2/5. Riya used the helpful idea that the dashes are like marks on a scale, and she identified that 2/5 uses 5 parts; the comparison with 1/2 was not confirmed during the lesson. At home, draw a line from 0 to 1, split it into five equal gaps, and label each gap while saying the fractions aloud.
